consistency_flags: The evaluated PDF states that a corrected online version first appeared January 12, 2023; publication remains Lancet 2022.
The printed reference list skips reference number 18 (numbering runs 1–17, then 19–26); the reference Markdown preserves the source numbering.
Safety-event definitions and capture windows differ between DELIVER and EMPEROR-Preserved, and the source explicitly did not directly compare or meta-analyse these safety events.
The five-trial meta-analysis is supportive/post hoc and had no assigned alpha; it should not be treated as the same inferential layer as the prespecified DELIVER + EMPEROR-Preserved analysis.
schema_gaps: LiteratureAtom has no dedicated systematic-review/meta-analysis atom kind; pooled meta-analytic results are represented with existing quantitative_result/subgroup_result kinds and descriptive tags.
extraction_limitations: Trial-level results were atomized when they directly supported pooled findings or safety context; bibliography entries were not atomized.

Supplementary multi-page class-specific subgroup and KCCQ figures were reconciled for SEA coverage, while the atom set prioritizes pooled independently reviewable assertions rather than duplicating every trial-specific panel value.
